title: Formulation switching (directive + codegen dispatch)
objective: Wire the `% mechanics formulation updated_lagrangian` directive from the frontend all the way through to the codegen, so a single LaTeX source (or programmatic `build_context` call) emits either a TL or UL generated solver file by flipping one directive.
scope: Remove the 'updated_lagrangian' supported-subset rejection in `mechdsl.frontend.build_context` (replaced with P1-1's ConfigurationIR path).
Update the P1-1 ConfigurationIR plumbing so ul and tl both flow through the same compile pipeline without branching at the frontend level.
Add a regression test that parses a LaTeX source with `% mechanics formulation updated_lagrangian` and compiles end-to-end to valid generated Python.
Update `test_frontend_build_context.py::test_formulation_updated_lagrangian_raises_unsupported_error` — this test is now obsolete and must be replaced with a success case.
implementation_steps: Touch `mechdsl.frontend.build_context` to accept `'updated_lagrangian'` in the allowed-formulation set.
Update the parser directive tests to reflect the new accepted value.
Add a compile-to-source round-trip test that emits both TL and UL from matched inputs and asserts the two source bodies differ while both parse as valid Python.
acceptance_criteria: `parse('% mechanics formulation updated_lagrangian\n...')` returns a valid context dict (no UnsupportedError).
The generator emits distinct source bodies for TL and UL on the same problem (both syntactically valid Python).
The frontend-subset-rejection test suite (P2 rejection analogues) still passes for dim/cell/material rejections — only the UL rejection was removed.

cases: UL emits different source than TL on the same inputs
TL rejection behaviour unchanged for other non-MVP values

risks: Removing a rejection that several tests assert against creates a wave of small test updates. Mitigation: update the test file as part of this task and audit that every remaining rejection test still exercises its intended Plan B phase guard.

commands.command: uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/ -m 'not slow and not gpu' -q

completion_notes: ProblemIR.__post_init__ auto-infers Configuration from Formulation when not explicitly provided (None default). Wires the end-to-end LaTeX directive → codegen path for UL. Explicit mismatches still rejected. 4 integration tests prove the round-trip.
